evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Accumulated experience is used to iteratively optimize prompts, utilities, and the video-generation workflow.
During operation, AesopAgent applies LLM-mediated memory editing to expert experience and professional knowledge; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Production experience is accumulated as reusable expert knowledge. For AesopAgent, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of expert experience and professional knowledge.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (expert experience and professional knowledge) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
